strategies.positive: Replace {target} with {replacement}. Keep everything else in the picture unchanged.
strategies.objectPositive: Replace {target} in image 1 with {replacement|the main object} from image 2. Keep everything else in image 1 unchanged and match its lighting and perspective.

{replacement|The new object from the first frame} stays in the scene with natural motion; the camera, lighting and everything else continue as in the first frame.
